definitions.explanation: Damage or deterioration in a thing: wear in a building or book, bruising or spoilage in fruit and food, damage to hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷|いた}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}って→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The paper in old books has deteriorated, so please handle them carefully.

notes:
The noun of ⟦{傷|いた}む→傷む：10061_itamu⟧ (to be damaged, to spoil).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傷|いた}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: badly damaged
- {傷|いた}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: spoils quickly
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷|いた}み: hair damage
- ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傷|いた}み: wear on the floor

WATCH OUT:
⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧ (pain) has the same reading. ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧ is pain a person or animal feels; {傷|いた}み is damage to a thing.
